CMOS correlated double sampler with hold
.include "circuit.spice"
.include "models.spice"
VDD vdd 0 3.3
VCM vcm 0 1.2
VT track 0 PULSE(0 3.3 1u 2n 2n 6u 10u)
VR reset 0 PULSE(0 3.3 1u 2n 2n 2u 10u)
VIN vin 0 PWL(0 0.8 4u 0.8 4.01u 0.6 9u 0.6 9.01u 1.2 14u 1.2 14.01u 1.0 19u 1 19.01u 1 24u 1 24.01u 0.6 29u 0.6 29.01u 1.1 40u 1.1)
XDUT vdd 0 track reset vin vcm out astra_016_cmos_correlated_double_sampler
.temp 27
.options method=gear reltol=1e-5
* @spec base range 0.995 1.015 unit=V
* @spec offset_residual range -0.001 0.001 unit=V
* @spec doubled range 0.8 0.82 unit=V
* @spec zero_input range 1.195 1.21 unit=V
* @spec hold_droop range 0 0.002 unit=V
.control
set filetype=ascii
tran 2n 40u
meas tran base FIND v(out) AT=8u
let error=v(out)-base
meas tran offset_residual FIND error AT=18u
meas tran doubled FIND v(out) AT=28u
meas tran zero_input FIND v(out) AT=38u
meas tran hold_droop PP v(out) FROM=7.2u TO=8.8u
write out.raw v(vin) v(out) v(track) v(reset)
quit
.endc
.end
